content: Travel bookings use the approved portal. Standard rail and economy air are reimbursable with an itinerary and receipt.
Hotel reimbursement is capped at the published city rate. Exceptions require written manager approval before booking.
Employees request planned leave in the people portal at least five working days in advance when practical.
Unexpected sick leave should be reported to the manager on the first day. A medical note is requested after three consecutive days.
Expense claims require an itemized receipt for purchases above 25 credits and must be submitted within 30 days.
Client meal claims list attendees and business purpose. Alcohol is excluded from reimbursement.
Application access is requested through the service catalog and approved by the system owner.
Access reviews occur quarterly. Managers remove access that is no longer required for a person's role.
Project working files are retained for two years after project closure unless a legal hold applies.
Approved contracts are retained for seven years after expiration in the records repository.
Priority one support covers a complete production outage and is acknowledged within 15 minutes.
Routine support requests are handled during business hours and receive an initial response within one working day.
New starters complete security awareness training during their first week.
Managers submit equipment requests at least ten working days before a new starter's first day.
Remote work is available up to three days per week when the role and team schedule permit.
Company information used remotely must remain in approved applications and managed devices.
Normal production changes require peer review, a test record, an approved window, and a rollback plan.
Emergency changes may use expedited approval but require retrospective review by the next working day.
